$comment: Everything uxagent ships for agents, with the module that carries it. `uxagent sync` renders the project's AGENTS.md block, skill stubs, and Cursor rules from this file.
`read` is a path under agents/, or `project:<path>` for a file in the project (written with the default layout; sync substitutes the configured design-system folder).
A route with `skill` is dropped when that skill is opted out, its module is off, or the project has its own skill of that name.

routes.when: `/ux-setup`, setting uxagent up, what is left to install or fill in, or skipping a tool
What a fully set-up project needs
Any work in the code (editing, adding, or debugging)
Which real command a role (`dev`, `build`, `validate`, …) maps to
A convention this project has learned
Styling components, writing CSS, or implementing a page from a design
Design patterns or guidelines: color, type, layout, elevation, shape, motion, accessibility, copy
routes.note: the matching file; index in its `README.md`
